notes: 'the clocks go back this weekend' is a fact, not a loop, and 'this weekend' must not become a due date on its own item. The concert set-up is part of the music-stand request.

items.title: Bring the music stands to the church hall
items.quote: Could you bring the music stands to the church hall on Saturday at 3pm?
items.note: Before the change: 3 PM BST = 14:00 UTC (15:00 would mean GMT was used).

items.title: Final running order from Nadia
items.quote: I'll email everyone the final running order on Monday at 10am
items.note: Written by Nadia, not the user. After the change: 10 AM GMT = 10:00 UTC (09:00 would mean the BST offset was kept).

items.title: Return the rehearsal folder to Mrs Patel
items.quote: please return your rehearsal folder to Mrs Patel by 30 October
items.note: UK day-month order. Counterparty is the person asking (Nadia); Mrs Patel is the recipient. evals/run.ts does not score counterparty.
